player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly moved back and forth between the same rooms (Library, Sauna, Wine cellar) without checking if I had already visited them, causing an infinite loop instead of exploring new areas. I did not maintain a mental list of visited rooms to track my progress. Next time, I will first list all currently visited rooms in my graph before making a move. When presented with a direction, I will check if the destination room is already in my visited list; if it is, I will immediately choose a different untried direction or stop if no new directions exist. I will only move to a new room if it is not yet in my graph's nodes, ensuring I never re-enter a known room unless necessary to reach an unvisited one, and I will declare "DONE" only when all reachable rooms are in my graph.
